insurer: THE NEW INDIA ASSURANCE CO. LTD

room_rent.note: Room, boarding expenses up to 0.5% of Sum Insured per day

icu.note: ICU charges up to 1% of Sum Insured per day

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the policy wording

sub_limits.display: Many sub-limits: 15% SI for surgeon/nursing fees, 15% SI for medicines/OT, ₹15,000 per illness cap
sub_limits.note: Section B capped at 15% of SI per illness; Section C capped at 15% of SI per illness; total per illness capped at ₹15,000; overall SI is ₹30,000

initial_waiting.note: First 30 days waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases excluded for 36 months from policy inception

specific_disease_waiting.note: Cataract, hernia, hydrocele, piles, sinusitis, fistula, BPH, hysterectomy for menorrhagia/fibromyoma, congenital internal disease and related disorders excluded for 12 months

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded under Excl18; ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses are defined but no specific number of days is stated in the policy wording

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses are defined but no specific number of days is stated in the policy wording

day_care.note: Specific day-care procedures listed: dialysis, chemotherapy, radiotherapy, eye surgery, lithotripsy, D&C, tonsillectomy, plus others agreed by TPA/Company

domiciliary.note: No domiciliary treatment benefit mentioned in the policy wording

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered up to 100% of Sum Insured per policy year

organ_donor.note: No organ donor expense cover mentioned in the policy wording

ambulance.note: Ambulance is listed under List I (items not covered) in Annexure I

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments listed (robotic surgery, oral chemo, intravitreal injections, stem cell therapy etc.) each covered up to Sum Insured

consumables.note: Gloves, masks, and many consumables explicitly listed under non-payable items in Annexure I List I

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly states all treatments must be taken in India and claims payable in Indian currency only

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes

free_look.note: Applicable on new individual policies with term of one year or more; not applicable on renewals or porting

portability.note: Portability to other insurers allowed as per IRDAI guidelines; migration within company also available

notable_exclusions: Ambulance, maternity, dental (cosmetic/wear), spectacles/hearing aids, circumcision, RFQMR/ECP/EECP/hyperbaric O2, venereal disease, suicide injury, war, NBC weapons
source_file: Policy Clause Universal Health Insurance Policy.pdf
